documents.title: Travis County FY2026 Adopted Budget (with Recapitulation Financial Statement)
documents.note: Adopted Sept 2025. General Fund $1,559,097,516; Road & Bridge $31,644,627; Debt Service $169,433,251. All-funds memorandum total ~$2.16B. Adopted tax rate $0.375845/$100. Recap statement pp.439-440.

documents.title: Travis County FY2026 Adopted Budget, Vol II — Department & Fund Summaries
documents.note: General Fund departmental budget history (Table 1, p.8): Sheriff $252.9M incl. the jail, TNR $91.4M, Technology & Operations $83.0M, HHS $71.8M, and dozens more.

documents.title: Travis County Financial Transparency Portal — Vendor Payment Register
documents.note: Travis County publishes a searchable Vendor Payment Register that ties each payment to the invoices and purchase orders it paid — one of the strongest county payment portals in Texas. Excludes payroll and jury payments.

documents.title: Travis County Annual Comprehensive Financial Report, FY2024
documents.note: Most recent audited financial report (FY ended Sept 30, 2024). External auditor Maxwell Locke & Ritter LLP — opinion to be confirmed from the Independent Auditor’s Report page.
